title: Code Reviewer per-job model entry, version 1
description: What a job is told about the model it runs with (#548, native OpenCode providers, #544): the one provider and the one model of the catalog read from models.dev (src/models-dev/), and nothing else of the catalog. It holds no secret: no key, no header value. `upstreamBaseUrl` is where the supervisor sends the real key; the engine is never given it, only the loopback address of the per-job proxy (#550). The runner turns the entry into the `provider.<providerId>` block of the engine's configuration: `npm` and `options.baseURL` (the proxy) with a dummy `options.apiKey`, and `models.<modelId>` as `model` says. Closed: a reader refuses a field it does not know, because the entry decides where a key goes and what the engine is told it may do. The writer is the app (src/models-dev/job-entry.ts); the version is in the path and in `version`.

ProviderId.description: The provider's id in models.dev (and in the supported-provider file, contracts/opencode-providers.v1.json).

ModelId.description: The model's id at the provider; the key of `provider.<providerId>.models`. The same rule as the runner's `llm.model` plus the `@region` suffix some providers use.

WireFamily.description: The wire format the pinned engine speaks to the provider's SDK: it decides the path the proxy allows and how the usage is read.

AuthHeader.description: The header the SDK of the family sends the key in; the proxy swaps the dummy key for the real one in this header.

Limit.description: Both `context` and `output`, always: the engine refuses a limit with one of them (`ConfigInvalidError`, spike #546). `input` is optional.

Interleaved.description: Where the model carries its reasoning in a tool loop, so the engine hands it back (`true`, or the field).

JobModel.description: The entry for `provider.<providerId>.models.<modelId>`. `status` is normalised: the pinned engine drops a model whose status is `deprecated` or `alpha`, so those are written as `active` (the warning is shown in our own screens, from the catalog) and `beta` runs as it is. `tool_call` is always true: the catalog stores no other model, and the engine does not enforce the flag. No price: the engine's own cost is not used (the ledger reads the raw usage of the provider).

npm.description: The bundled SDK of the pinned engine. Always set: without it the engine treats a provider it does not know as OpenAI-compatible and speaks Chat to it, whatever the provider is (spike #546).

upstreamBaseUrl.description: https only, no credentials, no query, and not a private, loopback or link-local address; trusted on first use and blocked until an admin confirms a change (src/models-dev/upstream-url.ts). Kept by the supervisor; never given to the engine.
